description: This file defines an abstract base class 'NativeResource' for managing native resources within the AWS CRT PHP SDK. It handles resource tracking, leak checking, and resource lifecycle management.

classes.name: NativeResource
classes.description: Abstract class for managing native resources, tracking all outstanding resources and providing leak checking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes static CRT instance if not already initialized and registers the resource in the static resources array.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Associates a native handle with this resource.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the native handle and returns it.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Ensures resource cleanup by asserting native handle is null and removing from tracking resources.
